Usage: yantra init [options]

Create or update ~/.yantra/config.yaml

Options:
  --provider <name>  default model provider: 'anthropic' | 'ollama' | 'none'
  --reset            back up existing files and rewrite from defaults (default: false)
  --json             emit a JSON status object after writing (default: false)
  --yes              accept defaults without prompting (default: false)
  -h, --help         display help for command
